name: @him0/freee-mcp
description: An MCP server and Claude plugin that enables interaction with freee APIs for accounting, human resources, invoicing, and more. It provides secure OAuth 2.0 authentication and integrates detailed API reference skills to support tasks like creating invoices and managing company data through natural language.
